title: A table function whose EXPR parameter is a measure evaluates it for each iterated row
query: VAR BestCustomersResult = FILTER ( Customer, metricExpr > AverageMetric )

source.quote: metricExpr is invoked in two different row contexts during two distinct iterations, and it needs to evaluate the sales of the customer being iterated through the context transition every time
source.supports: the article gives this function; the measure is evaluated per customer

source.quote: AVERAGEX ignores the blank values that Expression returns.
source.supports: the customer with no sales does not count in the average

derivation: Per customer: Ann 240, Bob 70, Cho 230, Dee BLANK. The average ignores the blank: ( 240 + 70 + 230 ) / 3 = 180. Above it: Ann (240) and Cho (230). Bob (70) and Dee (BLANK, which is not above 180) are not. Counting the blank as 0 would give 135 and the same two customers.
